decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building. The tiles used on the roof shall be clay tiles to match the existing.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (S/01, D/11) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in either flank wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Alterations on ground floor to provide a decontamination room, the erection of a first floor rear extension to accommodate an office and ancillary rooms together with alterations to the existing first floor flat
